scope: All 98 current wiki/spec Markdown documents at the pinned revision; proposals and drafts are not added normative requirements.

evidence_policy: Located files, README claims, headers and source assertions are candidates, not passing results. Area candidates are not automatically linked to every family. No tested-coverage percentage is computed.
